🐾 Welcome to Dr. Tony Lee – Pet Health & Vet Tips! 🐶🐱

Hi, I’m Dr. Tony Lee, a Small Animal Veterinarian, here to help pet parents better understand and care for their furry best friends. ❤️

On this channel, you’ll find expert vet tips, dog and cat health advice, pet nutrition, safe foods, grooming tips, common health warnings, and practical pet care advice to help your pets live healthier and happier lives.

Subscribe 🔔 to Dr. Tony Lee – Pet Health & Vet Tips for helpful veterinary advice every week!

⚠️ Disclaimer: This channel is for educational purposes only and does not replace professional veterinary diagnosis or treatment. Always consult your veterinarian for your pet’s specific needs.
